purpose: Prevent automatic Harborline geometry and native NPC placement until map exclusion zones can be surveyed when a known external map-expansion mod is installed.

behavior.resumeRequires: Remove the map-expansion mod from the Mods folder or replace this conservative guard only after an in-game survey establishes tested exclusion bounds and non-overlapping spawn coordinates.

caveat: File-presence detection is a conservative safety gate, not a compatibility test. It does not prove that a companion mod loaded successfully or that two mods are otherwise compatible.
